verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs show a first-party Cards API that issues, activates, and manages cards for customers alongside accounts and payments in the same API surface. However, the evidence never distinguishes virtual from physical debit cards and never mentions spend controls or digital wallet support. Missing for 10: explicit virtual and physical debit card issuance, documented spend controls/limits, digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Issues, activates, and manages cards for customers
